11.t: Working with data: groups get smaller
q: How many species are in the cat family?
Describe what happens to the number of species from kingdom to species.
It gets smaller at every level, from 1 500 000 to 1.
About how many times more species are there in the class Mammals than in the order Carnivores?
Use the table to explain why organisms in the same genus are more alike than organisms in the same class.

A genus contains only 7 species that share all the features of every level above (kingdom to family) plus the genus features; a class contains 6 600 that share only kingdom, phylum and class features. More shared levels means more shared features.
